svg.text: The module rail supplies qualified SD and OLED loads. Keep accessory wiring short and local.
Matching rail and remote labels are electrical joins. GND symbols share GND. X marks a deliberate no-connect.
Blue values open manufacturer documents. * Exact manufacturer or order code open.
Published electrical basis dae330c / c664df16. Existing review holds apply.
Insulate former VBUS lands. They carry SYS5.
X marks an unused pin or isolated pad.
Built-in GP16 pixel has no external link.
Fit J5 and J6 only after combined current and thermal qualification. Check OLED pull-ups and connector polarity.
J7 and J8 are 3.3 V data and common ground only. Connect or remove local accessories with power off.
